# Stop hermes-webui server
print("Stopping hermes-webui...")
result = subprocess.run(
    shlex.split("pkill -f 'hermes-webui server.py'"),
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

if result.stdout.strip():
    print("Signaled hermes-webui to stop:", result.stdout.strip())
else:
    print("No hermes-webui process running to stop")

# Start hermes-webui
print("\nStarting hermes-webui...")
result = subprocess.run(
    shlex.split("sleep 2 && nohup .hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python /home/runner/hermes-webui/server.py > /tmp/hermes-webui.log 2>&1 &"),
    shell=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    timeout=10
)

    print("hermes-webui started in background")
    # Verify it's running
    proc_check = subprocess.run(
        shlex.split("ps aux | grep 'hermes-webui server.py' | grep -v grep"),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    print("Running processes:")
    print(proc_check.stdout.strip() or "None found")
else:
    print("Failed to start: ", result.stderr)

import subprocess
import time

# Stop hermes-webui
print("Stopping hermes-webui...")
result = subprocess.run(
    ['pkill', '-f', 'hermes-webui'],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

if result.returncode == 0 or "no process found" in result.stderr:
    print("Hermed hermes-webui to stop\n")

# Start hermes-webui in background
print("Starting hermes-webui...")
proc = subprocess.Popen(
    ['/opt/hermes/venv/bin/python', '/home/runner/hermes-webui/server.py'],
    stdout=open('/tmp/hermes-webui.log', 'w'),
    stderr=open('/tmp/hermes-webui.err', 'w'),
    start_new_session=True
)
print(f"Started hermes-webui with PID: {proc.pid}")

# Wait a moment and check
time.sleep(2)
check = subprocess.run(
    ['ps', '-p', str(proc.pid), '-o', 'pid,comm,stat'],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

if check.stdout.strip():
    print("✓ hermes-webui is running")
else:
    print("✗ hermes-webui failed to start")
    print("STDOUT:", open('/tmp/hermes-webui.log').read()[-500:] if open('/tmp/hermes-webui.log').readset()))
    print("STDERR:", open('/tmp/hermes-webui.err').read()[-500:] if open('/tmp/hermes-webui.err').readset())

    ['ps', '-p', str(proc.pid), '-o', 'pid,comm,stat', '--no-headers'],

)

        print("STDOUT:", log_txt[-400:])
